title: Perturbation Output Schema v1.0
description: Schema for validating perturbation generation and validation output in the robustness evaluation pipeline.

task_id.description: Unique identifier for the original HumanEval task.

perturbation_type.description: The type of perturbation applied to the original prompt.

raw_score.description: The raw semantic similarity score (cosine similarity) calculated before any filtering threshold is applied.

is_valid.description: Indicates whether the perturbation passed the semantic similarity threshold (currently > 0.95).

candidate_text.description: The full text of the perturbed prompt.
